title: 1BR + Office Space with Private Garage – Noe Valley
body:
Located in a 1920s residential building in the Noe Valley area, this unit offers a flexible floor plan with one bedroom, one bathroom, a separate office space, and a private garage.

The layout includes an entry foyer, living room, kitchen, and dedicated dining area. Bay windows bring natural light into the main living spaces and offer views of the surrounding neighborhood and city skyline.

The bedroom includes a walk-in closet, while the additional room can be used as a home office, guest room, study, or extra storage space. Multiple closets throughout the unit provide additional storage options.

The bathroom features marble finishes, and hardwood flooring extends through the main living areas.

A private garage is included and can be used for parking or additional storage. Shared laundry facilities and radiator heat are available within the building.

Conveniently located near public transportation, parks, grocery stores, neighborhood shops, and local services throughout the Noe Valley and Dolores Park areas.

title: Charming one bedroom, one bathroom condominium in Noe Valley
body: This charming one bedroom, one bathroom condominium in Noe Valley has bright south-facing windows, high ceilings, an efficient floorplan and an incredible location. Walk to 24th St. in five minutes on flat streets, and commute easily on nearby BART, MUNI, and tech shuttles. The Victorian details in the living room frame the large windows, and the kitchen and bath are updated. Two assigned storage areas and common laundry complete this wonderful unit.

title: Bright top floor impressive western views condo on a great block
body: Spacious bright top floor view condo on a great block. Living room has handsome fireplace & details. Nice dining room with impressive western views. Home has period detail hardwood floors w/inlay, French doors, baseboard molding and bay windows. Kitchen is bright w/newer stainless appliances, cabinets, gas range, good prepping space + views. Office space nook, private entry + in unit laundry make this ++. Independent garage space is spacious w/bonus parking in front of the garage for guests. There is a large exclusive storage room with window and 2nd storage area. Home is minutes to all the Mission's best cafes, shops, parks + activities. Close to mass transit, corporate shuttle easy freeway access. A Walker+Biker Paradise 95 Walkscore.

title: Exceptionally chic & sophisticated 1BR/1BA condo & amazing backyard
body: Have you have ever dreamed of living in San Francisco & Paris & the Italian Wine Countryside, but want them all at the same time? If so, prepare to fall in LOVE with 49 Liberty St#3. Located in the heart of Liberty Hill Historic district, with greenery, mature trees & picturesque SF icons this is city living at its finest. This gracious condo & amazing backyard are a serene, city retreat within steps of city's culturally vibrant Mission Dolores & Mission Districts. This exceptionally chic & sophisticated 1BR/1BA condo is part of a spectacular 1880 Italianate Victorian 4-Unit Bldg. With outlooks to picturesque Liberty St, the rooms have soaring ceilings, softwood floors, beautiful chandeliers, & stunning architectural detailing. The sunlit kitchen has French doors opening to your exclusive deck & truly one of the most magical backyards in SF.Shared with the other units, this south-facing backyard is over 1,500 sq ft of professionally designed & landscaped gardens, stone walkways, & a fabulous outdoor eating area. Perfect for enjoying morning coffee or large scale entertaining, this oasis will have you feeling as if you've been transported to a wonderful Wine Country retreat. Good storage, laundry & garage parking. This exceptional property is a rare San Francisco jewel.

title: Special top floor 1BR condo with light-filled and stunning views
body: This special top floor condo has stunning views, a light-filled floor plan and a desirable location near the heart of Noe Valley and the Mission. It's in a gorgeous 1920's 6 unit corner building set on one of the highest points of palm tree-lined Dolores Street, one of the most iconic and coveted streets in San Francisco. With its impressive views from most of its rooms, great natural light, scale and smart layout, this 1 bedroom plus office condo feels larger than its square footage. It features a spacious living room, inviting bedroom, nice-sized kitchen and dining area, cozy office, bright bathroom, beautiful foyer and more closet space than most one bedrooms. Period details, hardwood floors, common laundry, a shared terrace and a private 1 car garage with additional storage complete this home. no HOA dues. Near numerous popular restaurants, cafes, shops, nightlife, Dolores Park, MUNI and BART. This well designed home can be your oasis in the city. The one you've been waiting for.
